nodes.label: Mirra (iPhone Mirroring tool)
nodes.rationale: Needs amfi arg, -wexnohwdecode, decoder.py edit for build 25G241.

nodes.label: WhateverXe.kext
nodes.rationale: Upstream b00t0x iGPU Tiger Lake driver; fork carries Sequoia/Tahoe fixes. Current 0.8.3 merged with fork flags.

nodes.label: WhateverXe-Graphics payload (0.4.4)
nodes.rationale: 0.4.4 makes -wexxferfix/-wexvafix/-wexleakfix/-wexnullguard obsolete.

nodes.label: XHCI-unsupported.kext (must stay enabled)
nodes.rationale: Hard rule: must always remain Enabled=True.

nodes.label: airplayfix tool (AirPlay mirroring black fix)
nodes.rationale: Forces receiver to output BGRA and sets enableGVATransfer=NO so VideoToolbox converts on CPU; GPU conversion hangs GPU.

nodes.label: Iris Xe Tiger Lake graphics patch
nodes.norm_label: iris xe tiger lake graphics patch
nodes.rationale: Gen12 Xe LP has no Apple driver; VESA only otherwise.

nodes.label: wrapTGLRecovery
nodes.rationale: Extends resetHardwareAndReplay to Sequoia so hangs recover instead of freezing.

nodes.label: amfi_get_out_of_my_way=0x1
nodes.rationale: Dash form never read by kernel; only name=value form works.

nodes.label: App Store GPU hang (VTDecoder fixed batch 0x402db000)
nodes.norm_label: app store gpu hang (vtdecoder fixed batch 0x402db000)
nodes.rationale: RCS hangs on PIPE_CONTROL waiting on EU kernel; known upstream issue.

nodes.label: Camera / video call GPU reset storm
nodes.norm_label: camera / video call gpu reset storm
nodes.rationale: Root cause was wexleakfix freeing in-flight POSH buffer; teardown drain alone insufficient.

nodes.label: Bounded engine reset (-wexnoreset toggles)
nodes.rationale: Donor GDRST wait has no time limit under host scheduling (no GuC), freezing machine; reset bounded to 50 ms.

nodes.label: -wexleakfix / TGL POSH leak fix
nodes.rationale: 2-byte patch frees POSH buffer even with a POSH batch in flight, causing GPU restart loop; needs -wexnoposh.

nodes.label: -wexnoccs
nodes.rationale: Clears EnableMultiContext so compute contexts on CCS are not created; stops mediaanalysisd restart storm.

nodes.label: -wexnohwdecode
nodes.rationale: Hides HEVC hw decode; refuses IGAccelVideoContext::attach for VTDecoderXPCService so decode is software while H.264 hw encode survives. Earlier variant removing IOGVACodec killed encode (-12908).

nodes.label: -wexnoposh
nodes.rationale: Runs RCS contexts without POSH; fixes camera/video call GPU reset storm. Verified by TGLNoPOSHLive.

nodes.label: SMBIOS placeholder identifiers
nodes.rationale: Repo uses placeholders; user must generate own with GenSMBIOS.

nodes.label: -vi2c-force-polling
nodes.rationale: Fixes dropped APIC/GPIO interrupts on Dell for I2C touchpad.

nodes.label: VA driver crash +0x1336f3 (GVA pixel transfer)
nodes.rationale: NULL slot 0x910/0x918 store in renderer object; shared stack with WindowServer/AirPlay crashes; fixed by XFER page fix, later obsoleted by Graphics 0.4.4.

nodes.label: Realtek ALC295 layouts test plan
nodes.rationale: Try alcid 33,77,13,3,15,75 in turn if audio/mic fails.

nodes.label: PerfLimitProbe (rolled back)
nodes.rationale: Panicked at boot; do not reintroduce.

nodes.label: SSDT-ECDPTF.aml (EC DPTF mode)
nodes.rationale: EC reg 0x32 was 0 because macOS reports no DTT driver; calling DPST(1) at boot removes periodic PL1 clamp.

nodes.label: SSDT-PL1.aml
nodes.rationale: Raises PL1/PL2 only; effective PL1 in MCHBAR+0x59A0.

nodes.label: SSDT-PL1.aml
nodes.rationale: Writes PACKAGE_RAPL_LIMIT via MCHBAR: PL1 18 W, PL2 28 W; only raises; skips if BIOS lock bit 63.

nodes.label: VoodooPS2Controller
nodes.rationale: Mouse and Trackpad plugins disabled to avoid conflict with I2C.

nodes.label: -vi2c-force-polling
nodes.rationale: APIC/GPIO dropped interrupts; polling gives smooth tracking.

nodes.label: AirDrop iPhone SE2 / iPhone 7 test results
nodes.norm_label: airdrop iphone se2 / iphone 7 test results

nodes.label: sharingd/rapportd restart fix
nodes.rationale: Restart fixes iPhone to Mac AirDrop stuck at Waiting; recurrence after boot possible.

nodes.label: Intel SGX Disabled
nodes.rationale: Avoids memory conflicts with macOS kernel.

nodes.label: AirportItlwm.kext (fallback)
nodes.rationale: Kept disabled as rollback.

nodes.label: BTLEAdvFixup 0.9.1
nodes.rationale: Advertises BLE so iPhone sees Mac; conflicts with IntelBTPatcher (same function hook).

nodes.label: ForbiddenItlwm 0.5.4-beta.2
nodes.rationale: Adds AWDL for AX201; replaces AirportItlwm; beta, mostly AI-written, risk of panic/WiFi loss.

nodes.label: btpin LaunchDaemon
nodes.rationale: BlueToolFixup patched bluetoothd in page cache; APFS 16 KiB compressed chunk eviction causes hash mismatch SIGBUS. btpin mlocks patched chunks.

nodes.label: S0ixStandby.kext (labrouss 0.5.4)
nodes.rationale: macOS never asks for S3; sleeps in Deep Idle and kext calls firmware Modern Standby _DSM.

nodes.label: SSDT-S3.aml (fake _S3)
nodes.rationale: Disabled for Deep Idle; fake _S3 produced black screen hang; needs _OSI Darwin guard if Windows boots via OC.

nodes.label: Intel AX201 Wi-Fi
nodes.rationale: Shared radio: Wi-Fi slows 30-45% while AirDrop listens.

nodes.label: com.apple.wifip2pd launchd service
nodes.rationale: If disabled, macOS never asks driver to create awdl0.

nodes.label: USB port map
nodes.rationale: HS05 fingerprint disabled to avoid D3 hang; HS10 internal BT required.

nodes.label: AppleIntelFramebuffer slow ack
nodes.rationale: Framebuffer SetState takes ~646 ms; mitigated by watchdog=0 and igfxonln=1.

nodes.label: USB wake assertions (2.4G receiver, 58200)
nodes.rationale: Fingerprint 58200 has no driver, fails D3 ACK; disabled in USBMap.

nodes.label: wifip2pd 30 s sleep timeout
nodes.rationale: itlwm stack stalls wifip2pd on sleep.

nodes.label: PEPD device (INT33A1, Modern Standby _DSM)
nodes.rationale: PEPD._STA needs OSYS>=0x07DF so macOS cannot see it; SSDT-PEPD-STA plus OC rename PEPD._STA to XSTA exposes it.

nodes.label: -s0ixacnortc
nodes.rationale: Avoids known freeze on AC after dark wakes.

nodes.label: -s0ixecwake (dropped)
nodes.rationale: Armed EC GPE 0x6e so power button woke, but keyboard dead after wake; dropped.

nodes.label: S3/S4 sleep failure (no S3 firmware)
nodes.rationale: Kernel log 'ACPI: sleep states S4 S5'; S3 hang, S4 resume failed 5 times with EFI/Bootrom failure.

nodes.label: PC711Probe.kext
nodes.rationale: SSD MSI-X interrupt compat driver; not loaded on macOS 26 because MaxKernel 24.99.99.

nodes.label: CPUFriend + CPUFriendDataProvider
nodes.rationale: Floor 1.0 GHz, ceiling 4.4 GHz with HWP.

nodes.label: PC711Probe.kext v1.8.1
nodes.rationale: Fixes SK hynix BC711 MSI-X timeout panic after EXITBS.

nodes.label: Fastboot = Thorough
nodes.rationale: Fully initialises keyboard, trackpad, USB before OpenCore.

nodes.label: SATA/NVMe Operation = AHCI/NVMe
nodes.rationale: RAID On hides BC711 SSD from macOS.

nodes.label: Secure Boot Disabled
nodes.rationale: Required to boot OpenCore.

nodes.label: SpeedStep / Speed Shift Enabled
nodes.rationale: Needed for CPUFriend.

nodes.label: VT-d Enabled
nodes.rationale: OpenCore DisableIoMapper quirk makes it safe.

nodes.label: SK hynix BC711 NVMe
nodes.rationale: MSI-X incompat causes timeout panic after EXITBS.

nodes.label: Display Sleep workaround (pmset)
nodes.rationale: Avoids S3 deadlock black screen with fans running; superseded by Deep Idle with intentional pmset values.

nodes.label: Deep Idle sleep (S0ixStandby)
nodes.rationale: Firmware has Modern Standby only; replaces SSDT-S3 and S4 hibernation. Cpuid1Data spoofed Ice Lake.

nodes.label: WindowServer memory leak (Metal POSH buffer)
nodes.rationale: AppleIntelTGLGraphicsMTLDriver skips delete on 0x12010-byte POSH buffer, ~76 KB per command buffer. Patching on disk black-screened (platform binary signature), so in-memory patch via Lilu.
